cohort_total_n_excerpt: The study group consisted of 197 men affected with prostate cancer and 197 healthy men.
reason: The study compares men with prostate cancer with healthy controls and reports associations with overall prostate cancer. No aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint is analyzed.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: When compared in quartiles a significant association of higher zinc concentration with the incidence of prostate cancer was observed.
estimate_classifications.reason: The zinc estimate concerns overall prostate cancer, with no aggressive subtype specified.
